name: Misto, de znovu yde doshch
source:
You return to the city where you spent your entire childhood. In 10 years, almost nothing has changed, the town is just as neglected and gloomy, but familiar landscapes still warm. At the station, you are met by your childhood friend, sweet and cheerful Abell. But you didn't tell anyone about your return...

[Translated from [url=https://ryugodson.itch.io/thesitywhereitrainsagain]itch.io[/url]]
